Columns run from A for the line number, B for the label, and C for the code, then annual values and quarterly values. If the annual columns cover 2019 to 2022 (D to G), the quarters start at H for 2019Q1. That would place 2020Q2 at column L, so the address would be Table1!L8. This is a guess.
